Rae (People Ops): Quick update — annual SOC2 evidence collection closes in 8 days. Read this post for exception process and quick upload tips.
Omar (Eng): Thanks Rae. If we have a live incident log that contains customer data, can we submit an excerpt instead of full logs?
Sophie (Security): Excerpts are fine if they show the relevant control behavior and are redacted for PII. Include a short note in the manifest explaining redaction.
Ben (Compliance): For any redactions, add a signed approver (name + email) in the manifest. Auditors require proof of authorization.
Rae (People Ops): Exception process: use the attestation exception form (link below) and mark the artifact status as "exception-pending". Exception requests approved by Compliance get a 14-day extension normally.
Rae (People Ops): Links: training: https://training.redwood.example.com/soc2-2026  upload: https://files.redwood.example.com/soc2-uploads  exception form: https://forms.redwood.example.com/attest-exception
AttestBot: Reminder: 8 days left to submit. 4 artifacts still unsubmitted for your team.
Omar (Eng): One more: file naming — do we keep dashes or underscores? Last time naming inconsistencies tripped validation.
Ben (Compliance): Use underscores. Pattern: <control>_<owner>-<YYYYMMDD>_evidence.pdf. Exact punctuation matters.
Sophie (Security): Also: include timezone-aware timestamps in logs (ISO 8601 preferred). If you export from Kibana, use the UTC export option.
Rae (People Ops): Bulk uploads ok but include a manifest.csv at the root (columns: filename, control_id, owner, notes, approver). If you upload a zip, set filename to <team>-bulk-<YYYYMMDD>.zip.
Omar (Eng): Uploading infra artifacts now (will include manifest and approver email).
AttestBot: Upload detected from omar. Manifest: present. Item count: 12.
Ben (Compliance): Received. We'll triage within 48 hours. If we need follow-up, you'll get a comment in the manifest and a DM.
Rae (People Ops): FYI — teams in EMEA with GDPR constraints, DM me if you need a localized reviewer; we can route your artifacts to Lina in Legal for a first pass.
Omar (Eng): Noted. Thanks all.
Rae (People Ops): Final: anyone needing an exception should apply at least 72 hours before the deadline to avoid automatic failing status. Office hours tomorrow 3pm PT for last-minute questions.
